human_reorganization: The paper uses real Hilbert L2 quotient spaces on the original countable Gaussian source. It never identifies the full ambient space with its Brownian-generated subspace. The density has the negative sign exp(-X Y-X^2/2).

The actual source proves full time-one past law equality, not merely equality of the two endpoint marginals. Corrected terminal independence and covariance are derived from actual Gaussian translation.

The general positive-density subspace equality iff square root is observable, and its Bayes rewriting, are complete classical human deductions. The actual example unitary, conjugated projection and conditional intertwiner are named formal results.

The formally recorded projection-operator gap is only a one-vector lower bound 1-sqrt(2/3). Exact norm one uses new printed rare-past-event test vectors and the elementary universal bound for differences of orthogonal projections; it is not labelled as an additional Lean theorem.

The parameter-family norm discontinuity and integrated root-overlap formula are explicitly printed human deductions from the conditional fibers and Gaussian square integral. No strong-operator discontinuity is inferred.

The explicit two-stage predictable coefficient is a classical human construction via conditional Gaussian integration, localized Ito calculus, L2 removal of stopping and the original isometry. Its uniqueness identifies the original formal representer. No closed Malliavin derivative membership is assumed.

Terminal stochastic-exponential normalization and Novikov divergence are actual formal declarations; the full density-process martingale calculation is a separately printed classical deduction. No new general Girsanov theorem or Q-Brownian construction is claimed.

Section 10 adds the source static independent-Gaussian lognormal volatility proxy with exact real-power interval [0,1]. Arbitrary epsilon>0 scaling, the tilted-law interval [-1,0], failure of every positive root moment under Q*, finite two-way entropies equal epsilon^2*exp(2*a^2)/2, the root-distance bound and the actual delayed Brownian density-process martingale are complete HUMAN deductions. Tiny two-way entropies do not imply any higher-density moment. The deterministic a=0 exception is explicit. Neither a new stochastic-volatility principle nor a general model equation is claimed.
